issues.title: WP3 evidence singleton ran in a contaminated process
issues.rootCause: generate-evidence.js executed production probes and the in-process singleton scenario in one Node process while inheriting runtime path and mutex authorities.
issues.fix: Run singleton evidence in a dedicated sanitized Node process; make generator import-safe; force deterministic TAP summary and validate complete test counts.
issues.verification: New direct tests 3/3 and isolated singleton 9/9 checks PASS; full Windows WP3 pending.

issues.title: WP4 evidence required tests used shell glob execution
issues.rootCause: shell:true caused C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe to be parsed as C:\Program; wildcard expansion also depended on cmd.exe behavior.
issues.fix: Enumerate every tests/wp4/*.test.js file in JavaScript, invoke process.execPath directly with shell:false and TAP reporter.
issues.verification: New command/parser tests 2/2 PASS; full Windows evidence generation pending.

issues.title: WP5 clean repository gate was invalidated by earlier evidence outputs
issues.rootCause: WP3/WP4 evidence defaulted to untracked directories inside the Git worktree before verify:wp5.
issues.fix: Support external WP3 evidence root and require the Windows runner to place WP3/WP4 evidence under the external evidence bundle before the WP5 clean-repository check.
issues.verification: Cross-workpackage static contracts 3/3 PASS; full Windows continuous sequence pending.
